name: 整列頁首＋標誌左、導覽置中、功能區右，下緣分隔線，手機側邊抽屜選單
desc: 橫跨全寬、跟著頁面捲動的頁首列。標誌在左，一列導覽連結置中，一組圖示按鈕在右，元素延伸到接近畫面左右邊緣，下緣有一條分隔線。手機版標誌置中，選單從左側滑入、內含分頁切換與分組連結。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，跟著頁面捲動，不固定：標誌在左，導覽連結置中，功能區在右，所有元素在同一水平線上垂直置中。內容不受頁面內容寬度限制，標誌與功能區延伸到接近畫面左右邊緣，只留少許邊距。導覽連結是一列小字，明顯小於標誌；導覽項目較多，整列約佔畫面寬一半。功能區可放一組圖示按鈕，沒有時省略。頁首下緣有一條分隔線。
mobile: 頁首仍是整列，排列改為：左側放選單按鈕，旁邊可放一個圖示按鈕；標誌置中；右側放一組圖示按鈕，沒有時省略。導覽連結收進選單面板：點選單按鈕後，選單面板從畫面左側滑入，約佔畫面寬九成，右側露出被遮暗的頁面；頁首仍留在面板上方，選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕。面板頂端有兩個並排的分頁切換，目前的分頁下方有底線；下方的導覽連結靠左直向排列，每一項右側有箭頭，連結分成數組，每組上方可放小標題並以分隔線隔開，沒有時省略；面板最下方有一塊底色不同的區域，可放數個次要文字連結，沒有時省略。有子項目時點擊後在面板內展開。

en.name: Full-width header bar + logo left, navigation centered, actions right, bottom divider, mobile side drawer menu
en.desc: A full-width header bar that scrolls away with the page. The logo is on the left, a single row of navigation links is centered and a group of icon buttons sits on the right, extending close to the left and right edges of the viewport, with a divider along the bottom edge. On mobile the logo is centered and the menu slides in from the left, containing tab switches and grouped links.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, which scrolls away with the page, with the logo on the left, the navigation links centered and the actions group on the right, all elements vertically centered on the same horizontal line. The content is not limited to the page content width; the logo and the actions group extend close to the left and right edges of the viewport, keeping only a small margin. The navigation links are a single row of small text, clearly smaller than the logo; there are many navigation items, and the row takes up about half the viewport width. Optionally place a group of icon buttons in the actions group; omit it when there is no content. A divider runs along the bottom edge of the header.
en.mobile: The header stays a full-width bar, rearranged as follows: the menu button on the left, optionally with one icon button next to it; the logo centered; a group of icon buttons on the right, omitted when there is no content. The navigation links move into the menu panel: tapping the menu button slides the menu panel in from the left side of the viewport, taking about ninety percent of the viewport width, with the dimmed page visible on the right; the header stays above the panel and the menu button turns into a close button. At the top of the panel are two side-by-side tab switches, with an underline below the active tab; below them the navigation links are left-aligned and stacked vertically, each with an arrow on its right, and the links are split into several groups, each optionally topped by a small label and separated by a divider, omitted when there is no content; at the very bottom of the panel is an area with a different background that can hold several secondary text links, omitted when there is no content. Items with sub-items expand inside the panel when tapped.

extras.name: 頁首上方的資訊條
extras.prompt: 在頁首上方加一條橫跨全寬的公告條：中間放一段短文字連結；左右兩側可各放一個小圖示加次要文字連結，沒有時省略。公告條比頁首矮，跟著頁面捲動。
extras.mobile: 公告條只留中間的短文字連結，左右兩側的次要文字連結隱藏。

en.name: Info bar above the header
en.prompt: Add an announcement bar spanning the full width above the header: a short text link in the center; optionally a small icon with a secondary text link on each of the left and right sides, omitted when there is no content. The announcement bar is shorter than the header and scrolls away with the page.
en.mobile: The announcement bar keeps only the short text link in the center; the secondary text links on the left and right are hidden.
